title: A method that overrides or implements a documented method inherits its doc comment under `--strict-docs`, and `nvs doc` shows it
scope:
which public members `nvs check --strict-docs` reports (`E0326`), and what `nvs doc` shows
for a method with no `///` of its own. Properties, constants and every other diagnostic are unchanged.
dependsOnText:
[0137](0137.md) (`--strict-docs` reports a public member with no doc comment, and
`nvs doc` renders the `nvs meta --json` document), [0233](0233.md) (the document names a class's
parent and interfaces).

summary.headline: An override uses the doc comment of the method it replaces
summary.body:
`nvs check --strict-docs` no longer reports a method that implements a documented interface
method or overrides a documented parent method. That method uses the parent's `///` comment.
`nvs doc` shows that comment on the method and names the class or interface it comes from.
